old_caption: The video showcases a close-up of a decorative candle lamp placed on a round table. The lamp features a cylindrical glass container filled with a glowing blue liquid, which simulates the appearance of a lit candle. The flame at the top is a bright orange-yellow, flickering gently to mimic the movement of a real candle flame. The color of the liquid inside the lamp remains blue throughout the video, creating a mesmerizing effect. The base of the lamp is dark, contrasting sharply with the illuminated contents above. The background remains consistently dark throughout the video, ensuring that all attention is focused on the lamp itself. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera remains stationary, maintaining a steady focus on the lamp.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases a close-up of a decorative candle lamp placed on a round table. The lamp features a cylindrical glass container filled with a glowing blue liquid, which simulates the appearance of a lit candle. The flame at the top is a bright orange-yellow, flickering gently to mimic the movement of a real candle flame. As the video progresses, the color of the liquid inside the lamp shifts from blue to purple, creating a mesmerizing effect. The base of the lamp is dark, contrasting sharply with the illuminated contents above. The background remains consistently dark throughout the video, ensuring that all attention is focused on the lamp itself. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera remains stationary, maintaining a steady focus on the lamp and its changing colors.
caption: The video showcases a flameless electric candle on a dark turned candlestick holder atop a round table against a black background, a thin power cord trailing to the right. Its translucent cylindrical body is filled with a churning stream of bubbles lit from within, while a small orange LED flame flickers at the top. Across the excerpt the internal illumination drifts gradually from a cyan-teal glow toward a brighter blue-white glow, and the wax drip crown shifts from cyan to pale white-pink. The orange flame tip continually alters its shape and tilt, leaning and growing taller or shorter, while the candle body stays still. Intermittent colored glints of magenta, pink and green flash within the bubble column, most noticeable from the middle onward. The reflected light pool on the tabletop changes in the same rhythm, starting cyan and turning blue-white with faint pink tints. The candle, holder and cord remain fixed throughout, with no camera motion.
